notes: דּוֹר לְדוֹר is read as three units — 'One generation', 'to', 'another' — since the ASV spends a distinct English word on each morpheme and rule 30's one-rendering condition is therefore unmet; the supplied contrastive 'One' joins the first noun's unit under rule 15 and is never the head.

'mighty acts' heads on 'mighty' under rule 31's subtraction test, consistent with the same phrase at PSA.145.12; the competing reading heads on the generic noun 'acts', which rule 31 expressly refuses.
No added or unrepresented units: every target token answers to a morpheme standing in the verse.
